name: crm-os
description: Local CRM OS for small B2B pymes: contacts, organizations, deals, configurable pipelines, activities, notes, custom fields, CSV import, pipeline reports, Gmail sync via Forger Desktop, product catalog, quotes with line items, and heuristic lead scoring.

changelog.summary: Successor to CRM Lite. Full CRM for Pyme B2B with quotes and lead scoring.
changes: Manage contacts, organizations, and their relationships locally.
Configurable pipelines with custom stages and a default sales pipeline.
Track deals with amount, currency, probability, expected close date, and stage history.
Log typed activities (call, email, meeting, task) and free-form notes by deal, contact, or organization.
Define custom fields per entity and reuse free-text values across records.
Import contacts and organizations from CSV with dry-run preview and error report.
Built-in reports: pipeline value, won and lost by month, activities overview, and stage conversion.
Gmail sync and send through Forger Desktop's official tool, with idempotent import by message-id.
Local product catalog with SKU, default unit price, currency, and category.
Quotes per deal with line items, configurable tax, discount per line, status transitions, and yearly Q-YYYY-NNN numbering.
Heuristic lead scoring per deal (0–100) explaining the contribution of stage probability, recent engagement, inbound replies, freshness, and amount.

catalog.short_description: Local-first CRM OS for small B2B pymes, with quotes and lead scoring.
catalog.description: CRM OS keeps contacts, organizations, deals, activities, notes, products, and quotes on your machine. Configure pipelines and stages, log calls, emails, meetings and tasks, sync emails through your connected Gmail in Forger Desktop, build quotes with line items, and use heuristic lead scoring to prioritize who to push without sending data to a third-party CRM.

capabilities.title: Guardar contactos y empresas localmente
capabilities.description: Mantiene contactos, empresas y sus relaciones en una base local.

capabilities.title: Manejar pipeline de deals
capabilities.description: Pipelines y stages personalizables con monto, moneda, probabilidad y fecha estimada de cierre.

capabilities.title: Registrar actividades y notas
capabilities.description: Llamadas, emails, reuniones, tareas y notas asociadas a deals, contactos o empresas.

capabilities.title: Importar contactos y empresas desde CSV
capabilities.description: Carga archivos CSV con vista previa y reporte de errores.

capabilities.title: Reportes locales del pipeline
capabilities.description: Valor en pipeline, ganados y perdidos por mes, conversion por stage y actividades pendientes.

capabilities.title: Sincronizar y enviar correos por Gmail
capabilities.description: Registra correos de tu Gmail conectado como actividades de contactos y deals, y envía follow-ups desde la app.

capabilities.title: Catálogo local de productos
capabilities.description: Mantiene productos con SKU, descripción, categoría, precio unitario default y moneda, listos para cotizar.

capabilities.title: Cotizaciones con line items
capabilities.description: Genera cotizaciones por deal con productos del catálogo o líneas libres, descuentos, IVA editable y numeración Q-YYYY-NNN.

capabilities.title: Lead scoring local
capabilities.description: Puntaje 0–100 por deal calculado a partir de stage, engagement reciente, respuestas inbound y antigüedad. Sin LLM, todo local.

scripts.verify: cd backend && uv run pytest && cd ../frontend && npm run verify
